name: v150_interest_carry_core_subindustry
hypothesis: v149 may have been weakened by absolute nonoperating penalties and coarse INDUSTRY grouping. Test the pure interest-income / net-interest carry core at SUBINDUSTRY peer level.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.340 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(fnd6_iints) / assets, 126), subindustry) + 0.280 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(fnd6_nxints) / assets, 126), subindustry) + 0.150 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(vec_avg(fnd6_nxints) / assets, 252), 126), subindustry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.110 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Ablation of XgpzMnox: remove nonoperating absolute penalty and use subindustry peer ranking. Close if Sharpe stays below 1.35.

name: v150_positive_nonoperating_carry
hypothesis: The sign of nonoperating income may matter more than absolute cleanliness. Positive nonoperating income excluding interest plus positive interest carry may capture investment-income contribution rather than accounting noise.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.42, 0.280 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(fnd6_nopxs) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.240 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(fnd6_iints) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.200 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(fnd6_nxints) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(vec_avg(fnd6_nopxs) / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.090 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.070 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)
notes: Tests sign rather than low absolute nonoperating item. Reject if it becomes ordinary quality/value or weak.

name: v150_interest_carry_change_largecap
hypothesis: Improving interest carry may be more informative than the level, especially for large-cap companies where coverage and sub-universe robustness should be better.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.58, 0.310 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(vec_avg(fnd6_iints) / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.300 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(vec_avg(fnd6_nxints) / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(fnd6_iints) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.100 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_nopxs)) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.080 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.050 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)
notes: Change-dominant repair for potential level crowding. Large-cap gate is meant to test sub-universe robustness, not to hide small-cap dependence.

name: v150_interest_carry_no_beta_reversal
hypothesis: If v149's weak result was dominated by generic beta/reversal auxiliaries, the raw carry core should reveal whether the economic parent has independent strength.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.42, 0.390 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(fnd6_iints) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.330 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(fnd6_nxints) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_nopxs)) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(abs(vec_avg(fnd6_nopxs)) / assets, 252), 126), industry), -1)
notes: Pure parent ablation with no beta/correlation/reversal. If weak, the carry route should be closed.

name: v150_interest_carry_low_market_corr
hypothesis: Interest/nonoperating carry may work only when market correlation is low; this tests a regime gate without using debt, lease, buyback, option, or social fields.
expression: trade_when(correlation_last_90_days_spy < 0.68, 0.300 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(fnd6_iints) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(fnd6_nxints) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_nopxs)) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(vec_avg(fnd6_iints) / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.080 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)) + 0.060 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Regime-gated repair. Do not continue if the gate only lowers turnover without raising Sharpe/Fitness.
